data.name: Warnings list view
data.States: ShowingAll, Filtered, NothingShown, NoGroups. A separate machine per group row has Collapsed, Expanded, AlwaysOpen and Stuck.
data.Transitions: Mount to ShowingAll while no kind is picked `web/src/components/states.tsx:248`. ShowingAll to Filtered when a kind toggle is picked `web/src/components/states.tsx:260`. Filtered to ShowingAll when the last kind is cleared `web/src/components/states.tsx:249`. A row goes from Collapsed to Expanded on the Show files button, which exists only when its count is above one `web/src/components/states.tsx:224`. A row with a count of exactly one is always open `web/src/components/states.tsx:230`.

refs.quote: const shown = kinds.length === 0 ? groups : groups.filter((group) => kinds.includes(group.kind))

data.name: Info box open state
data.Transitions: Closed to Open when the pointer has stayed on the trigger or the box for 400 ms `web/src/components/metric-info.tsx:92`, when the trigger gets keyboard focus `web/src/components/metric-info.tsx:134`, or on a click `web/src/components/metric-info.tsx:143`. Open to Closed when the pointer has been outside both for 250 ms and the trigger is not focused `web/src/components/metric-info.tsx:105`, on a second click, or on any close request of the popover `web/src/components/metric-info.tsx:116`.

data.name: Hidden columns and shown columns can disagree
data.Risk: When a reader unchecks every column, the table guard returns the full column list, so the table still shows every column while the chooser shows every box unchecked. `web/src/components/columns.tsx:59` `web/src/components/columns.tsx:85`
data.Mitigation: Either keep the last column checked and disabled in the chooser, or show an explanation when the guard applies.

data.name: A failed copy of the start command gives no feedback
data.Risk: The offline card swallows a rejected clipboard write, so on a browser that blocks clipboard access the button stays at Copy command and the reader is not told that nothing was copied. `web/src/components/states.tsx:300`
data.Mitigation: Show a short failure label or select the command text so the reader can copy it by hand.

data.name: Empty warnings and empty charts draw nothing
data.Risk: The warnings list, the time chart, the sparkline and the context bars return an empty area or nothing when they have no data, and the component gives no message, so a page that forgets its own empty card shows a blank space. `web/src/components/chart-time.tsx:95` `web/src/components/states.tsx:272`
data.Mitigation: Pages already pass an empty card in most places; add the same in every place that renders these parts, or give the parts an empty message prop.

data.name: Every info box keeps a timer and one global pointer listener
data.Risk: Each info box starts its own 100 ms interval for its whole lifetime, and one pointer listener is added to the window at load and never removed, so a table with many badges runs many timers. `web/src/components/metric-info.tsx:79` `web/src/components/metric-info.tsx:37`
data.Mitigation: Start the timer only while the pointer is near or the box is open.

data.name: A test title says the opposite of what it checks
data.Risk: The rank test named picks measured as the best expects the result derived, which is the worst of the two inputs, so the title misleads a reader of the test list. `web/src/components/rank.test.ts:28`
data.Mitigation: Rename the test to say that the worse of measured and derived wins.

data.name: Should a retry on the offline card show progress
data.Question: The Retry connection button only bumps a counter in the page and the card shows no pending or failed state, so pressing it twice sends two reloads. Is that intended?

data.name: Is the offline card matched by message text on purpose
data.Question: The app decides that the reader is offline by looking for a fixed sentence in the error text before it draws the offline card, so a reworded message would show the plain error card instead. Should the failure carry a typed marker? `web/src/App.tsx:251`
